summary.text: Megan Murray is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 37 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she assumed her current seat in December 2022.
She is a public school educator.

paragraphs.text: Megan Murray's career experience includes working as a public school educator.
Ballotpedia lists Murray's tenure in the New Hampshire House as beginning in 2018, and she assumed her current seat representing Hillsborough 37 on December 7, 2022.
She was assigned to the Environment and Agriculture Committee in 2019-2020, 2021-2022 and 2023-2024.
